rationale: The workflow already enables dependency caching via ruby/setup-ruby with bundler-cache: true in both the build and aws-emulator jobs, which satisfies the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE optimization intent. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern explicitly lists "An equivalent cache already exists" as a contraindication, so adding a separate actions/cache step for vendor/bundle would be redundant. The experiment evidence for layering an extra cache on top of bundler-cache has a null outcome and mixed results (elapsed slightly improved but median job runtime slightly worsened), so it does not support a change. fail-fast is already set to false, preserving all matrix outcomes, which is the appropriate setting for a multi-gemfile/multi-ORM test matrix where every result is required. Other patterns (cancel stale runs, custom timeouts, test selection/prioritization, Bazel, distributed cache, etc.) either lack measured evidence for this repository, have contraindications, require CI-service features rather than workflow edits, or would alter required-check coverage. No supported optimization is applicable without weakening coverage or adding unsupported changes.
